purpose: Blind guest-scenario set. Written from how Walt Disney World guests actually talk, not from Ask Rumbly's capabilities, and annotated only against the product contract in Docs/ASK_RUMBLY_SYSTEM.md. Two personas: someone on their first trip, and someone who visits often and asks about specific items and venues.
discipline: Scored once before any fix. Phrasing is deliberately uneven — lowercase, missing punctuation, run-on sentences, typos, and the trailing context guests actually type. Do not clean it up.

expectations.answer: The contract says Rumbly answers this from restaurant, menu, hours, location, cuisine, service-style, or Disney allergy-label data.
expectations.decline: Outside the contract: park operations, weather, live availability or waits, editorial ranking, allergy-safety judgment, kitchen process, or official policy.
expectations.either: In contract, but the current snapshot may honestly have nothing. An answer or an honest no-match both count; a clarification does not.
